improvement_advice.advice: Brace your core and keep shoulders, hips, and ankles aligned; keep all three visible from the side.
Finish each repetition by straightening the arms to at least 175 degrees without losing body alignment.
Use a controlled 2-3 second repetition; cadence is reported separately and does not alter the weighted form score.
Keep your neck neutral and gaze toward the floor rather than reaching your chin forward.
Record through the final lockout so the last repetition can be assessed.

not_assessed.elbow_flare: Needs a front or 45-degree camera view.
not_assessed.chest_clearance: Needs floor calibration to measure the 5 cm distance.
not_assessed.knee_contact: Needs a suitable view and calibrated floor/contact detection.

interpretation_limits: Angles are estimates from 2D landmarks and depend on camera position, visibility, and pose-model accuracy.
A body-line angle at the hip is a proxy and does not establish full spinal alignment or diagnose injury risk.
The 0-100 score applies the workbook's three weighted binary checks; it is not a learned expert score or medical assessment.
